170 on intervals is normal territory for hard efforts, and it's the point of them. The idea of a "fat loss zone" is mostly a myth, though. Lower-intensity work burns a higher share of fat while you're doing it, but what drives fat loss over weeks is the total energy balance, and that comes down to how much you eat and how much you do overall. Hard intervals earn their place because they're time-efficient and build fitness. Easy days build your base and keep you recoverable, so a mix is better than chasing one zone.

Wrist trackers can also drift on intervals, so treat 170 as a rough guide. How you feel and how repeatable the efforts are tell you more. If you want, I can look at your recent cardio and see how your week is balanced.
